environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF association on the ALB. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn on port 8080. The /api/users/search endpoint is publicly accessible.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS:443 listener, default action forward to target group
